seo.title: Run any Python tool without installing it #python #uv

scenes.narration: Ruff is a Python linter, and it is not on this machine anywhere. One command runs it, checks the folder, and then it is gone again. Nothing added to any project.

uvStage.headline: A tool you never [installed]

scenes.narration: uv builds a throwaway environment off in its cache, drops the tool in, runs it, then stops caring. Your project is never touched.

uvStage.headline: Built, used, [let go]
uvStage.premise: A throwaway environment in the cache. The bay is empty before and after.

scenes.narration: Now run it again. Five point seven nine two seconds the first time, ten megabytes fetched and unpacked. Nought point two nine four the second. Same command, same machine, seconds apart.

uvStage.headline: Five seconds, then [a third of one]
uvStage.premise: The same command run twice. The only difference is where the parcel came from.
